# Great companies come from the big dreams of determined leaders.

We invest in founders with the imagination, tenacity & collaborative spirit needed to turn big ideas into even bigger businesses.

We invest across seed to growth stages in Southeast Asia and India. Once we spot a great team, build conviction and invest, we are all-in.

## Multi-stage

We are motivated by opportunities across sectors & categories with a typical cheque size ranging from $500k to $20M.

## Generalist

We always reserve follow-on capital to ensure the founders we support never lose momentum.
